title: 第一章 逆天改命！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

下午三点，泉城，金城小区出租屋。

“江灵，我的小宝贝，这几天可憋死我了…”

“讨厌，我才刚洗完澡…”

屋外叶凡身体一震，血液直冲头顶。

他知道后面声音主人是谁。

他女友，江灵！

他们是大学同学，在一起四年，毕业后，他们约定找到工作，攒一年钱就结婚。

但现在工作难找，半年下来，他投了无数简历，都石沉大海，只能一边跑外卖，一边投简历。

直到今天，他成功面试一份珠宝鉴定工作，想回来给江灵报喜，就撞见这一幕。

啪啪声响起，叶凡听着怒到极点，轰一声踹开房门。

沙发两人吓了一跳，滚落下来。

当看到来人是叶凡，江灵脸色一变，男人愣了下，露出玩味笑容。

“哈哈，叶凡，你今天回来够早的。”

“王岩！”

叶凡脸色铁青，他认识这人，是自己大学同校花花公子，泉城有名的富二代！

“呵呵，叶凡，其实我和小灵的事我早想和你说，但小灵一直觉得不是时候，不过现在正好，大家把话说开，也就行了。”

王岩笑道，一边说，他还一边拿根烟点燃。

叶凡额头青筋跳动，不在看王岩，看向江灵。

“叶凡，你现在还认不清自己么？你就是个农村出来的穷鬼！跟着你我只能一辈子挤出租屋，吃外卖，买廉价货！”

江灵眼神冷漠，“而王岩能给我买包，买首饰，住豪宅，你能吗？你连个像样的礼物都送不起！我早受够你了！”

“我们这四年算什么…”

“算什么？除了各取所需还能算什么？这四年你没少给我买饭，照顾我，我同样没少陪你睡觉吧，你装什么纯情呢！”

叶凡脸色一僵。

他没想到，江灵会说出这种话！

这还是那个温柔体贴的江灵么？

“哈哈，叶凡，你听到了？这是江灵自己选的。”

王岩大笑，“当然，考虑到咱们是同学，我也不能没表示，这样，我拿两万块，这事算过去了，如何？”

闻言，叶凡双拳握紧，怒视王岩。

“呵呵，怎么？嫌少？不对吧，对你一个农村出身的人来说，这已经很多了…”

“多你妈！”

闷响传出，叶凡给了王岩一拳，王岩鼻血横飞！

“草！你他妈找死！”

王岩怒吼，拳腿如风打向叶凡。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Three o'clock in the afternoon, rental house in Jincheng Community, Quancheng.

"Jiang Ling, my little baby, you've been suffocating me to death these past few days..."

"I hate it, I just took a shower..."

Outside the house, Ye Fan's body was shaken, and blood rushed to the top of his head.

He knew who the owner of the voice behind was.

His girlfriend, Jiang Ling!

They were college classmates and had been together for four years. After graduation, they agreed to get married after finding a job and saving money for a year.

But it's hard to find a job now. After half a year, he submitted countless resumes, but none of them came to fruition. He could only submit resumes while running takeaways.

Until today, he successfully interviewed for a jewelry appraisal job and wanted to come back to tell Jiang Ling the good news, when he bumped into this scene.

There was a snapping sound, and Ye Fan was so angry that he kicked the door open with a bang.

The two people on the sofa were startled and rolled down.

When he saw that the person coming was Ye Fan, Jiang Ling's expression changed. The man was stunned for a moment and showed a playful smile.

"Haha, Mark, you came back early enough today."

"Wang Yan!"

Ye Fan's face was livid. He knew this man. He was a playboy from the same university as him, a well-known rich second generation in Quancheng!

"Haha, Ye Fan, actually I wanted to tell you about Xiao Ling and I, but Xiao Ling always felt that it was not the right time. But now is the right time, so we can just talk about it."

Wang Yan smiled and while talking, he lit a cigarette.

The veins on Ye Fan's forehead throbbed. He was no longer looking at Wang Yan, but at Jiang Ling.

"Ye Fan, can't you recognize yourself now? You are just a poor guy from the countryside! With you, I can only live in a rented house, eat takeout, and buy cheap goods for the rest of my life!"

Jiang Ling's eyes were cold, "Wang Yan can buy me bags, jewelry, and live in a mansion, can you? You can't even give me a decent gift! I've had enough of you!"

"What have our four years been like..."

"What does it count? What else can we do besides getting what we need? In the past four years, you have bought me food and taken care of me. I have also slept with you. Why are you pretending to be innocent!"

Ye Fan's face froze.

He didn't expect Jiang Ling to say such things!

Is this still the gentle and considerate Jiang Ling?

"Haha, Ye Fan, did you hear that? Jiang Ling chose this himself."

Wang Yan laughed, "Of course, considering that we are classmates, I can't help but say so. How about I take 20,000 yuan and let this matter be over?"

Hearing this, Ye Fan clenched his fists and glared at Wang Yan.

"Haha, what? Too little? That's not right. For a person like you who comes from a rural area, this is already a lot..."

"Mom more!"

There was a muffled sound, and Ye Fan punched Wang Yan, causing Wang Yan's nose to bleed!

"Fuck! You're looking for fucking death!"

Wang Yan roared angrily, hitting Ye Fan with his fists and legs like the wind.
